inputs.photos: folder path (or cloud folder ID) for dump (an uploads dump); prefer SKU sticker shot first or one folder per shirt

returns.intake: grouped by SKU, photo counts, measurements, flaws, cleaned listing set, output path Listed/{SKU}
returns.drafts: title, description, price, category/specifics, photo order, schedule date

idealRequests.process_photos: Process photos in folder <path> (Uploads dump). Group by SKU sticker, build listing photo sets with approved format. Save under Listed/{SKU}. Report groups, measurements, flaws. Do not list.
idealRequests.create_listings: Create NEW eBay drafts for SKUs [...]. Prices from attached table. Schedule after the owner approves each. Do not publish until he approves.

cannot: write to original photo dump folder
